subject: Urgent: retention package request for Mina Haddad — accelerated vesting + spot bonus
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent retention ask — Mina Haddad (DataOps)

Hi Grace / Laura / Monica,

Quick heads-up — Mina (DataOps lead on realtime-ingest) just got a firm counteroffer from Nimbus Analytics. She told me this morning; they are offering base + 25% and an equity refresh. Mina is a critical IC: she led the last incident mitigation, owns the KV-cache refactor, and is the only person with the rollout playbook for our EU low-latency rollout. Risk of losing her between now and Q3 is material for the product roadmap.

I am requesting an exception approval for a short, targeted retention package:
- One-time spot retention bonus: $35,000 (paid as lump sum)
- Accelerated partial vesting: immediate vesting of 20% of her unvested RSUs (one-time)
- One-time relocation/reimbursement stipend: up to $5,000 (she might be evaluating a move)

Attached: Mina_Haddad_Perf_Summary_20270413.pdf and a quick cost model (Retention_Cost_Model_Mina_20270414.xlsx).

Justification in one paragraph: Mina's ongoing ownership of the KV cache refactor and our EU rollout reduces a multi-week outage risk; replacing her would delay the roadmap by at least two quarters and materially increase hiring/time-to-product costs. Given the competitor’s offer, the combined package still comes in below the projected cost of replacing her and the customer churn risk tied to the release timelines.

Ask: Can comp committee + finance pre-approve this exceptional package so we can present a counter today? If approved, we will route forms to payroll and DocuSign.

Happy to jump on a quick call.

—Marcus
Director, Data Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Mina_Haddad_Perf_Summary_20270413.pdf; Retention_Cost_Model_Mina_20270414.xlsx
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent retention ask — Mina Haddad (DataOps)

Thanks Marcus — I read the attachments. Appreciate the clear rationale and the modeling. A few quick clarifying asks before I bring to comp committee:
- Confirm Mina's current unvested RSU quantity and the dollar equivalent of 20% you proposed (the excel has assumptions but please confirm current grant details).
- Is Mina willing to accept deferred payout of the spot bonus (e.g., 50% now, 50% 6 months) or does she want a lump sum?
- Any legal/visa considerations? She’s on an H1B? (I think she’s on domestic full-time; please confirm.)

Operational note: if we approve accelerated vesting, we need a curation in Workday with a note citing exec/comp exception and an approval path from VP People + Finance. Laura — can you run this in comp committee today afternoon if we provide numbers? Rishi — I’ll need a quick confirmation on cap exposure (FY27 cash + P&L impact).

I’ll hold a 30-min slot at 3pm PT for a quick alignment if useful.

—Grace
People Partner, Product & Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-04-14T13:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent retention ask — Mina Haddad (DataOps)

Grace / Marcus — I reviewed the perf summary and the cost model. High level: committee is sympathetic given the counteroffer and Mina's criticality. Before we can sign an exception, we need these artifacts:
1) Exact unvested RSU count and grant IDs (so Legal can prepare the vesting amendment);
2) Manager attestation of replacement cost estimate (hire + ramp), and a short risks table (2–3 bullets);
3) Proposed payment schedule language for the spot bonus (tax treatment differs if deferred).

If Marcus can provide 1–3 by 2pm PT, I can escalate to the VP People for a provisional sign-off and loop in Rishi for the cash cap. Otherwise we’ll have to take the earliest comp committee slot tomorrow morning.

Laura Bennett
Head of Total Rewards
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-15T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Urgent retention ask — Mina Haddad (DataOps)

Thanks all — finance reviewed Marcus’s cost model. Quick summary:
- Spot bonus $35k OK from a headcount/cash-cap perspective; preferred structure is 50% now / 50% in 6 months (to protect against immediate departure).
- Accelerated vesting of 20% of unvested RSUs: finance will allow one-time acceleration up to 20% provided Legal signs the amendment and the cost is expensed in FY27. We need the grant IDs and the dollar value estimate — I can provisionally approve up to $120k of equity acceleration expense.
- Relocation stipend $5k is fine as a one-time expense.

Action items for processing:
1) Laura to confirm comp committee provisional approval.
2) Marcus to provide grant IDs and confirm bonus payout preference by EOD.
3) Grace/Monica to prepare the Workday amendment form and the DocuSign packet.
4) If approved, payroll (payroll@gusto-payroll.com) will process the cash payments (Grace/Monica to include the correct tax code).

Rishi Malhotra
VP Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-15T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Final: provisional approval + next steps for Mina Haddad retention package

Team — thanks for the quick turn. Summary / decision: provisional approval granted for the package with the following concrete terms:
- Spot retention bonus: $35,000 paid 50% immediately and 50% after 6 months, contingent on continuous employment.
- Accelerated vesting: 20% of Mina’s current unvested RSUs to be vested immediately via a Workday amendment and RSU grant amendment (Legal will prepare). Finance approved up to $120k equity expense.
- Relocation stipend: $5,000 one-time reimbursement.

Marcus: please confirm Mina’s grant IDs and whether she accepts the deferred spot structure by 3pm PT today. Laura: please move this through the VP People signature and confirm the comp committee minutes. Monica: please prepare the DocuSign packet and Workday amendment; route to Mina for signature once Marcus confirms grant IDs. Payroll contact will be payroll@gusto-payroll.com — Monica, include payroll tax codes for the 50/50 payout plan.

I’ve started a DocuSign envelope draft (link: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC-RET-2027) and copied Mina on this message so she sees the timeline. Mina — we’ll aim to have the cash tranche available in the next payroll run if you sign the DocuSign packet by EOD.

—Grace

Redwood Inference
